scope: Two separate AI-agent stdlib/Git artifact audits and coordinating-parent publication review. No candidate/model imports, inference replay, annotation decode, GT errors, confidence scores or threshold fitting. These are independent artifact checks, not independent model replication.

timing.note: These exclude orchestration preparation and publication; per-frame times are counted once per frame and are not complete-process throughput.

allowed_differences: calibration count fixed10 and evaluation progress/next-group allocation
shared software only g-031; final g-024 batch phase

prelaunch_failure.evidence_scope: Saved JSON reports an actually observed tool-shell exit per coordinating parent; this read-only Git audit verifies its source binding and no-model preparation control flow, not a separately retained raw stderr or wait4 capture. No global inactivity attestation.

artifact_map_boundary: Group verifier maps omit their own reports and postrun files. Aggregate map includes closed prior reports/postruns, omits its own report and current batch_audit receipt/stdout/stderr. Candidate Git tree plus final parent source/log bindings retain those four excluded files; no self hash.

publication_checks.scope: Read-only Git-blob text/hash/publication review; pattern checks are not a comprehensive secret detector.

candidate_ci.evidence: Parent read exact candidate run metadata and actual job logs. Later review-only publication head and merged-main checks must be separately verified before reporting publication complete.

publication_transport.fallback: Already-authorized repository connector published the candidate tree, independently checked via local Git. No account, permission or credential changes.
publication_transport.boundary: Transport failure was observed by coordinating parent, not represented as a Git-artifact raw wait/log receipt.

limitations: Local reviewer validates published cloud cache/package/source records; actual cloud cache bytes are not locally available or rehashed here.
Native paths and entry/RECORD hashes do not attest every installed package/native file.
Raw model outputs are checked without annotations; no accuracy or reliability result follows from finite/grid validation.
The postrun parent records its child exits; its own exit has no further supervisor receipt.
Published scoped execution records are not global cloud-activity attestation. Exact candidate CI is reviewed separately by parent.
Preparation failure exit1 is a saved tool-observation narrative with source binding, not a separately retained raw parent wait/stderr receipt.
The original g-033 parent-wrapper exit remains unavailable/null; no replay or reconstructed exit.
NumPy 2.0.2 is a version-matched reconstruction, not byte-exact historical environment reproduction.
Shared assets/camera and unresolved scene relationships/checkpoint exposure constrain the exploratory pilot. No method efficacy, scene generalization or real-robot claim.
This review does not hash itself. The final Git commit binds the completed review and documentation.
